params.body:
The header ended on the user's name followed by an "Afmelden" button, two items side by side at the end of a long menu.

## What changes

- **A user menu.** The header shows the signed-in name with a chevron. A click opens a small menu under it, with the email address and "Afmelden"; a click outside or Escape closes it.
- **One component.** It is `x-gebruiker-menu`, used in the full office menu and in the short menu of a handover-only view.
- Logging out works as before; since #103 it keeps a werf sign-in on the same browser.

## Tests

`UserMenuTest`: the header holds the menu button, the name, the address and Afmelden, in that order. Full suite green. Checked in headless Chromium with the menu open.
